layers.message: Record project context, scope, and design for the order status filter
Record approved development plan for the order status filter

graderOnly: The Developer style files relevant to the approved plan are universal, TypeScript, React, Next.js, HTML, and SQL. HTML applies because DEV-002 states that the page's rendered markup changes (a new filter nav and a Customer column). SQL applies because DEV-001 changes lib/sql/recent-orders.sql.

The plan states that there are no stylesheet changes (it reuses .pill-nav, .data-table, and .muted from app/globals.css), so css.md does not apply. The repository contains no Python files, so python.md does not apply.

Repository-enforced rules live in scripts/format.mjs and scripts/lint.mjs. The formatter enforces no statement-ending semicolons in .ts/.tsx/.mjs, 2-space indentation, at most 100 columns, and no trailing whitespace. Lint enforces lowercase SQL keywords and no select * in lib/sql/*.sql, no SQL template strings passed to .query(), no any, no console.log in app/ or lib/, and no 'use client' directive in page.tsx. Both pass on the built commit.
The project uses Next.js 15.1. In that version a page's searchParams prop is a Promise, and app/customers/page.tsx already awaits it.
No conflict exists between the repository's formatter, lint, or framework constraints and the scope or design.
Next.js and the other npm dependencies are not installed and the npm registry is blocked, so pnpm typecheck and pnpm build cannot run. pnpm format:check, pnpm lint, and pnpm test run offline.
app/customers/page.tsx (which uses index keys), lib/customers.ts, lib/money.ts, lib/db.ts, lib/sql.ts, and app/layout.tsx are unrelated to the plan.

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. Layer 00-project (pre-install) is a small Next.js 15 App Router dashboard in TypeScript/React with Postgres via pg. It has app/orders/page.tsx, app/customers/page.tsx, lib query modules that load SQL from lib/sql/*.sql, and node:test tests using fake Db objects. The repository's own formatter (scripts/format.mjs, pnpm format / format:check) and lint (scripts/lint.mjs, pnpm lint) are dependency-free so they run offline. next, react, pg, and typescript are declared in package.json but not installed. There are no Python files and no stylesheet work. Layer 10-cycle adds the Auditor CONTEXT.md, the scope (AC-001..AC-005), and the technical design, with STATE at DEVELOPING (STANDARD) and a FORWARD handoff from ARCHITECTING. Layer 20-plan adds the development plan: AUTONOMOUS, User Style NONE, locked, Status APPROVED, AFTER_IMPLEMENTATION/NONE. DEV-001 covers the SQL query and lib/orders.ts. DEV-002 covers the page, and states that its rendered markup changes and that no stylesheet changes are made. STATE.Development points at the plan and BlockedOn is NONE. Style-loading assertions 0-2 can only be judged from the trace. Assertions 3 and 4 have unchanged-file preconditions. Registry hosts are blocked so runs cannot install the Next toolchain.
